1. (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, __wherein the non-native compartment is heterologous to the cell__.

2. (Previously presented) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo.

3. (Previously presented) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme.

4. (Previously presented) The cell of claim 3 wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes.

5. (Currently Amended) The cell of [[either]] claim 3 [[or claim 4]] wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence.

6. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 [[any preceding claim]] wherein the BMC polypeptide comprises a Eut polypeptide.

7. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 6 wherein the Eut polypeptide comprises a EutS polypeptide.

8. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 [[any preceding claim]] wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides.

9. (Previously presented) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different bacterial species.

10. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different BMC operons __and wherein the non-native compartment is heterologous to the cell__.

11. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 [[any preceding claim]] wherein at least one BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag.

12. (Currently Amended) A method __for producing a non-native compartment in a host cell__ comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide __wherein the non-native compartment is heterologous to the host cell__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a bacterium __and the non-native compartment is heterologous to the bacterium__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Enterobacteriaceae __and the non-native compartment is heterologous to the member of the family Enterobacteriaceae__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 14 wherein the member of the family Enterobacteriaceae comprises E. coli __and the non-native compartment is heterologous to the E. coli__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Shewanellaceae __and the non-native compartment is heterologous to the member of the family Shewanellaceae__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a yeast __and the non-native compartment is heterologous to the yeast__.

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17 wherein the yeast comprises a member of the family Saccharomycetaceae.

19. (Previously presented) The method of claim 18 wherein the member of the family Saccharomycetaceae comprises Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises an alga __and the non-native compartment is heterologous to the alga__.

21. (Currently Amended) A method __for producing a product using a non-native compartment__ comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide __wherein the non-native compartment is heterologous to the cell__, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product.

22. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a bioactive product __and the non-native compartment is heterologous to the cell__.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a drug or a drug precursor __and the non-native compartment is heterologous to the cell__.

24. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a biofuel or a precursor of biofuel production __and the non-native compartment is heterologous to the cell__.

25. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the at least one enzyme catalyzes a step in degrading or detoxifying a toxic substrate __and the non-native compartment is heterologous to the cell__.

26. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 further comprising isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments __wherein the non-native compartment is heterologous to the cell__.

27. (Previously presented) The method of claim 26 wherein at least a portion of the non-native compartment comprise an affinity tag and isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments comprises contacting a sample comprising the non-native compartments with an affinity substrate having selective affinity for the affinity tag.

28. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 [[any one of claims 1-11]] comprising a plurality of compartments __wherein each compartment is heterologous to the cell__.
